description: FULL BODY. A Malaysian male in his late 30s with a neat, short haircut. He is wearing a formal dark blue Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) uniform including the professional blue collared shirt with insignias, dark navy trousers, and polished black leather dress shoes.
FULL BODY. A Malaysian woman in her 60s. She wears a traditional floral Baju Kurung in soft pastel colors and a neatly pinned light-colored hijab (tudung). She is wearing simple leather sandals.

FULL BODY. An anonymous, featureless human silhouette standing in front of digital displays. The figure is a dark, shadowy void with a glowing blue digital pulse emanating from the chest area to represent voice cloning, wearing a hooded jacket with no visible face or skin.

FULL BODY. A Malaysian male in his early 30s. He has clean-cut black hair and is wearing a smart-casual office outfit consisting of a tucked-in light blue button-down shirt, dark khaki trousers, and brown leather loafers.
